cards.target: Quem mandou essa mensagem?
cards.english: Who sent this message?

cards.target: Ele se barbeia todas as manhãs.
cards.english: He shaves every morning.

cards.target: Ele se machucou jogando futebol.
cards.english: He got hurt playing soccer.

cards.target: Vocês se ofereceram para ajudar?
cards.english: Did you offer to help?

cards.target: Ele se orgulha dos filhos.
cards.english: He's proud of his children.

cards.target: Eu me senti acolhido no Brasil.
cards.english: I felt welcomed in Brazil.

cards.target: A gente esperou por duas horas.
cards.english: We waited for two hours.

cards.target: Eu me sinto melhor depois de comer.
cards.english: I feel better after eating.

cards.target: Vocês se interessaram pelo projeto?
cards.english: Were you interested in the project?

cards.target: Ela saiu para comprar remédio.
cards.english: She went out to buy medicine.

cards.target: Para variar, ele chegou atrasado.
cards.english: For a change, he arrived late.

cards.target: Quero alguém que fale inglês.
cards.english: I want someone who speaks English.

cards.target: Ele se sentou perto da janela.
cards.english: He sat down near the window.

cards.target: Vocês se interessam por música brasileira?
cards.english: Are you interested in Brazilian music?

cards.target: Ele se concentra melhor de manhã.
cards.english: He concentrates better in the morning.

cards.target: A gente se vê amanhã então.
cards.english: We'll see each other tomorrow then.

cards.target: Eu me visto em cinco minutos.
cards.english: I get dressed in five minutes.

cards.target: Ele se acordou com o despertador.
cards.english: He woke up because of the alarm.

cards.target: Nós nos sentamos na primeira fila.
cards.english: We sat in the first row.

cards.target: Caso ele ligue, avisa pra mim.
cards.english: If he calls, let me know.

cards.target: Não existe professor que saiba tudo.
cards.english: There's no teacher who knows everything.

cards.target: Eu me inscrevi no curso de culinária.
cards.english: I enrolled in the cooking course.

cards.target: Ela se queixa do barulho dos vizinhos.
cards.english: She complains about the neighbors' noise.

cards.target: Preciso de alguém que entenda de informática.
cards.english: I need someone who understands computers.

cards.target: Eu me arrependo de não ter estudado mais.
cards.english: I regret not having studied more.

cards.target: Nos abraçamos e nos despedimos.
cards.english: We hugged each other and said farewell.

cards.target: Vocês se acostumaram com o calor?
cards.english: Did you get used to the heat?

cards.target: Eu preciso terminar isso para amanhã.
cards.english: I need to finish this by tomorrow.

cards.target: Por que ele não respondeu a mensagem?
cards.english: Why didn't he respond to the message?

cards.target: Nós nos encontramos no café às três.
cards.english: We met at the café at three.

cards.target: Nós nos adaptamos rápido à nova cidade.
cards.english: We adapted quickly to the new city.

cards.target: A gente se ajuda nos momentos difíceis.
cards.english: We help each other in tough times.

cards.target: Vocês se divertem com jogos de tabuleiro?
cards.english: Do you have fun with board games?

cards.target: Eu me surpreendi com a comida daqui.
cards.english: I was surprised by the food here.

cards.target: Caso você precise de ajuda, me liga.
cards.english: In case you need help, call me.

cards.target: Ele se cansou de esperar e foi embora.
cards.english: He got tired of waiting and left.

cards.target: Nós nos mudamos três vezes em cinco anos.
cards.english: We moved three times in five years.

cards.target: Ela se formou em administração.
cards.english: She graduated in business administration.

cards.target: Chovia muito quando a gente chegou.
cards.english: It was raining a lot when we arrived.

cards.target: Ele estudava quando a luz acabou.
cards.english: He was studying when the power went out.

cards.target: A gente conversava quando o chefe entrou.
cards.english: We were chatting when the boss walked in.

cards.target: Eu me levanto às seis da manhã.
cards.english: I get up at six in the morning.

cards.target: Eu me deito cedo durante a semana.
cards.english: I go to bed early during the week.

cards.target: Estou aqui para ajudar no que precisar.
cards.english: I'm here to help with whatever you need.

cards.target: É bom que você durma cedo hoje.
cards.english: It's good that you sleep early today.

cards.target: O show já tinha começado quando nós chegamos.
cards.english: The show had already started when we arrived.

cards.target: Vocês se deram bem com os vizinhos novos?
cards.english: Did you get along with the new neighbors?

cards.target: Eu me mudei para São Paulo há dois anos.
cards.english: I moved to São Paulo two years ago.

cards.target: A gente se encontra toda semana para um café.
cards.english: We get together every week for a coffee.

cards.target: Preciso de um hotel que fique perto da praia.
cards.english: I need a hotel that's near the beach.

cards.target: Ele se levantou cedo para ver o nascer do sol.
cards.english: He got up early to see the sunrise.

cards.target: Ela se olhou no espelho e sorriu.
cards.english: She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled.

cards.target: Vocês se deram bem na empresa nova?
cards.english: Did you get along well at the new company?

cards.target: Enquanto eu escrevia o e-mail, o computador travou.
cards.english: While I was writing the email, the computer froze.

cards.target: Eu estava no banho quando a campainha tocou.
cards.english: I was in the shower when the doorbell rang.

cards.target: Ele trabalhava como freelancer antes de ser contratado.
cards.english: He worked as a freelancer before he was hired.

cards.target: Ela se veste rápido para não se atrasar.
cards.english: She gets dressed quickly so she won't be late.

cards.target: Antes que a loja feche, preciso comprar pão.
cards.english: Before the store closes, I need to buy bread.

cards.target: Eu trouxe um casaco para o caso de esfriar.
cards.english: I brought a jacket in case it gets cold.

cards.target: Embora o preço seja alto, a qualidade é boa.
cards.english: Although the price is high, the quality is good.
